description: Which issue of the project's own Jira this issue is, and what that Jira says of it now — its summary, status, assignee and link — read with the token the project's administrator connected. 'connected' false means the project has no Jira; 'jira.state' is 'found', 'missing' (no such issue, or one the token cannot see), 'refused' (the token no longer opens the site), 'unreachable', 'off' or 'sealed'. Where the project keeps its statuses in step with that Jira (get_jira_sync), 'sync' says which way and, in 'problem', why the two were left apart: 'conflict' (both moved), 'no_pair_here' / 'no_pair_there' (a status with no pair), 'refused_here' (this project's workflow refused the move), 'no_move' (the site lists no move to the paired status), 'refused_there', 'missing', 'token'. Set the link with set_jira_link.
name: get_jira_link
title: Get Jira link
